scope: W8 local diagnostic and accounting evidence; no full Gate 1 claim
code_identity_limitation: These are closeout hashes, not contemporaneously captured code hashes for every run. The checkpoint and anchor diagnostics predate later edits to shared helper modules; do not represent these closeout hashes as proof of their exact historical code. The bundle receipt captures its declared receiver/renderer source hashes, and its hash-identified output remains available at the recorded path.
runtime: Checkpoint receipt records local torch 2.5.1 one thread; bundle and anchor used local CPU Python; these do not establish the packed production environment.
conservative_cpu_ledger: Suggested rounded charges: checkpoint 6 s; anchor 1 s; bundle 2 s; setup failure 1 s. Receipts snapshot process CPU before receipt publication/teardown, so these are estimates, not independently measured whole-process upper bounds. Transfers and other jobs are accounted separately.
